levels.surface: أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: Rule 11: al-Faqih's statement of his routes (طرق) to a book, with no saying; the book's author («أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي») is named only in the opening clause.
«فقد رويته عن أبي» is a bare relation (rule 7); the second route is written in full.
